title: haex-hive Atom Manifest v2
description: Schema for a per-atom manifest.json. Type-by-shape per D13: role derived from which contributes.* fields are set, plus optional includes[] for profile composition. See spec-007 FR-008, FR-009, FR-010.

id.description: Reverse-DNS atom-id. Must equal the publisher-root-manifest key that referenced this atom.

version.description: Semver X.Y.Z. Must equal the version the publisher root manifest declared for this atom-id.

priority.description: Publisher's default priority (D5). Consumer can override via config.<atom-id>.priority.

includes.description: Profile composition: transitively include other atoms.

defaults.description: Default values for the atom's config_schema.

config_schema.description: Path (atom-directory-relative) to the atom's config JSON Schema.

globPattern.description: Publisher glob pattern with / segment separators; * matches within-segment, ** matches across segments. Consumed by Spec 010.

constitution.description: Path to the atom's constitution.md contribution. Consumed by Spec 007.

spec.description: Path to a spec reference document. Consumed by Spec 010.

rules.description: Glob patterns matching rule files. Consumed by Spec 010.

hooks.description: Glob patterns matching Python hook files. Consumed by Spec 009 dispatcher.

skills.description: Glob patterns matching SKILL.md files. Consumed by Spec 010.
